negative_control.conclusion: The only Barbarossa runtime startable here declares itself 'development-single-host' with ha_qualified=False and activation_authority='none'. It therefore CANNOT produce ground truth for AC-SP94-2/3/4/5 and is used only to prove that.

owner_declared_topology.note: Non-HA truth for the management-readonly-local fragment (ADR-0007 BLR-2/BLR-9). Every API projection and receipt reports these values verbatim. A single-host local runtime cannot satisfy the SP-92 rendered-topology validator (>=3 spread API replicas, >=2 workers, PDBs, HPA) or the SP-94 HA qualification; the missing failure-domain quorum, autoscaling and failover axes stay not_qualified. Portal cannot render a missing HA axis as green, zero or satisfied.

overall_note: status is RED and cannot be otherwise while no committed SP-92 owner receipt exists and no named non-production HA environment receipt exists. buildable_checks_result=GREEN means every check that CAN be performed from committed artifacts passed -- it is not HA qualification, profile activation or production readiness, and it grants no infrastructure-mutation authority.
